orgName: Emerald Queen Casino (Puyallup Tribe of Indians)

source.name: MLSsoccer.com: 'Seattle Sounders FC enter sleeve sponsorship agreement with Puyallup Tribe of Indians' Emerald Queen Casino'
source.quote: to make EQC the club's Official Casino and Entertainment Partner through 2027, the club announced Tuesday

note: Right-sleeve partnership; logo placement on the right sleeves of the primary (EQC logo) and secondary (Puyallup Tribe salmon emblem) jerseys. Value not disclosed. Still on the kit in 2026 (FOR SOCCER's 2026 MLS jersey sponsors list).
